author: prabal04das
content: So, it is like while going offline, it saves the sync committee and after coming online, it starts from that committee up to current sync committee linearly. If so, then how long can the client remain offline before its stored sync committee is considered unsafe? Thanks for the clarifications 🙂

author: dirkjaeckel
content: Why would a past verified sync committee be considered unsafe ever? The only problem I see is that the sync committee is so old that the client has a harder time finding cl nodes that still serve the update. In my experience a month's old sync committee update is not a problem.
